For optimal care of fig trees (*Ficus carica*), provide full sun to encourage vigorous growth and fruit production. Fig trees thrive in temperatures between 60-85°F (16-29°C) and prefer moderate humidity, though they are drought-tolerant once established. Use well-draining soil with a pH of 6.0-6.5, slightly acidic to neutral. Water deeply when the top 2-3 inches of soil are dry, ensuring the roots do not sit in waterlogged conditions. Fertilize in early spring and mid-summer with a balanced fertilizer like 10-10-10 to support healthy growth and fruiting. Prune annually during the dormant season to remove dead wood, shape the tree, and encourage airflow to reduce the risk of pests and diseases. With proper care, fig trees will reward you with a bountiful harvest of sweet and nutritious fruits.
